lines.say: The pull-up. Here's what it really works.
Your lats, the big wings of your back, pull your body up.
Your mid back and your biceps help.
Your forearms and grip hold you on the bar.
Palms facing you? That's a chin-up, and your biceps work harder.
Can't do one yet? Jump to the top and lower yourself slowly.
Or use a resistance band to take some of your weight.
